The '''Prospector Limpet Controller''' launches limpets that scan an asteroid and reveal its mineral composition and yield potential before a Commander commits to mining it.

== Overview ==

Prospector limpets are one of four original Limpet Controller types (alongside [[Collector Limpet Controller|Collector]], [[Fuel Transfer Limpet Controller|Fuel Transfer]], and [[Hatch Breaker Limpet Controller|Hatch Breaker]]), and are considered essential for efficient mining: without one, a Commander is mining asteroids blind, with no way to tell a rich deposit from a low-value one before spending time and Mining Laser cargo-hold-space on it. A Prospector scan is normally paired with a [[Collector Limpet Controller]] to actually retrieve whatever the mining process breaks loose.
